base.architecture: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; text backbone only is loaded

hardware.node: single node, 8 x H200, direct SSH, no scheduler
hardware.variant_check: nvidia-smi name ('NVIDIA H200' = SXM, 'NVIDIA H200 NVL' = NVL) with power.default_limit or power.max_limit (700 W SXM, 600 W NVL), cross-checked with topo -m; current power.limit and clocks recorded only; plan NVL timing if inconsistent
hardware.driver_minimum: 570.26 (CUDA 12.8 GA Linux) for the main stack; 525.60.13 to 570.26 uses the backup stack; below 525.60.13 S0 fails
hardware.local_machine: RTX 5080 16 GB (sm_120); native Windows .venv: Python 3.12.13, torch 2.8.0+cu128, transformers 4.52.4, no triton, no fla; cannot hold 27B; micro-model smoke in WSL2 Ubuntu

notation_constants.F_0_definition: F_base(2048); common absolute cost unit for all documents and policies
notation_constants.flop_convention: 2mnk matmul only; GDN counted in recurrent form

part1_original.scope: executable implementation of the original idea plus engineering definitions; single decider copy, per-token per-iteration decisions, four actions, Canopy 10-slot prior and jev recipe, loop exit = block-60 input; deviations from the literal form listed in plan section 1.3

reading_of_choose_loop_count.chosen: per-iteration: after each iteration the copy decides loop or stop; cost r*a per token
reading_of_choose_loop_count.request_level: the decider reads the prompt and picks one loop count for the whole answer (v2.1 plan section 3.1; v3.1 training-free question-level policy; part 3 H-req and Canopy zero-training readout); cannot host per-step emit and expert
reading_of_choose_loop_count.alternative: one-shot: copy reads h60^(1) and picks r in 1..4 once, plus expert and tool slots; cost a per token; pending decision 7

deviations.part1: iteration 1 frozen; iterations >= 2 carry 18776064 LoRA params on layers 48-59 plus gamma
independent slots, per-layer-input fill, on-demand accounting, coverage correction
answer-first position for QA plus up to 4 hashed scored positions, t = 1 only, at most one call per document
separate call-rate budget K and dual price lambda_tool; barycentric interpolation
stage P fits rows A-D, then frozen
adds exact-expectation arm E and auxiliary-only arm S
tilted deployment on the unsmoothed prior logit; equals Canopy argmax at zero tilt
speed only from a separate wall-clock measurement, never inferred from FLOPs

loop_segment.deviation: literal original form is [0-59]; [48-59] chosen per improvement 16
loop_segment.exit: h60 feeds the original layers 60-63 + lm_head (generation) and the decision copy
loop_segment.injection: z_1 = e = h48; z_t = e + gamma * (h60^(t-1) - e) for t >= 2; gamma in R^5120, FP32, zero init, no weight decay

iteration_ge2_lora.targets: all nn.Linear in layers 48-59 except in_proj_a/b/z
iteration_ge2_lora.deviation: departs from 'first 60 layers frozen' (improvement 13); r = 1 path still equals the frozen model

loop_segment.positions: same position id for a token in every iteration, passed explicitly
loop_segment.slots: slot(l,1)=l; slot(l,t)=64+12(t-2)+(l-48) for t=2..4 (64-99); generation tail 60-63; decision copy 100+4(t-1)+(l-60) (100-115); expert tail 116-119
loop_segment.exactness: gamma = 0 and B = 0 reproduce the original model for any depth assignment (section 4.6)

state_semantics.cache: self-written LoopCache; independent slot per iteration
state_semantics.rule: token j at iteration t reads and writes only slot t
state_semantics.holes: P1a fill: for t > r_i, layer l writes state from x_{i,l}^{(r_i)} with iteration-t weights; state-only projections
state_semantics.accounting: on demand: (i,t) charged iff some j > i has r_j >= t; charged to the triggering decision; eager filling allowed, not charged
state_semantics.training: parallel masked execution: inactive positions carry the previous iteration's layer inputs; equivalent to online execution (appendix E)

loop_training_L0.data: half fineweb-edu-dedup rows >= 400000, half math web corpus (user choice); 13-gram decontamination against GSM8K, MATH, PopQA; sequence length 4096, EOS-joined
loop_training_L0.depth_distribution: per sequence granularity in {whole sequence, 32-token blocks, per token} = first 8 bytes of SHA256(seed || sequence || 'gran') mod 3; per unit r = first 8 bytes of SHA256(seed || sequence || unit) mod 4 + 1
loop_training_L0.loss: per-token CE at the token's own exit; chunked fused CE, 2048 tokens per chunk, FP32
loop_training_L0.backprop: iterations 2-4, generation tail and lm_head fully unrolled; layers 0-47 no_grad; iteration 1 not backpropagated

decision_copy.structure: independent copy of layers 60-63 + final RMSNorm, frozen 1522079904 params; LoRA r16/scale 32/dropout 0, 6258688 params, init from Canopy adapter
decision_copy.input: h60_j^(t) after iteration t (unnormalised block-60 input)
decision_copy.decision_context: slot t holds earlier tokens written from h60^(min(t, r_i)); later copy layers carry the iteration-r_i layer inputs

prior_stages.P: fit rows A-D and bias with soft-label CE; standardised coordinates folded back; full-batch L-BFGS with strong Wolfe line search, at most 2000 iterations, stop when the gradient norm <= 1e-6 x its initial value; L2 in {1e-3..1e2} by 5-fold grouped CV; temperatures fixed
prior_stages.A: prior frozen; adapter trained with the jev recipe

decision_copy.cost_per_decision: a = F_cyc/F_base = 0.0595; copy fill f = 0.0067 per missing slot; readout 102400 FLOPs
decision_copy.deploy_score: unsmoothed prior logit l_t(a) (after temperature, before the probability transform); smoothed log pi differences are bounded (K=2: 4.634, K=3: 4.987, K=4: 5.238) and saturated rows flip together at b = bound/(4a) = 19.48, 20.97, 22.02 without fills; part 1 loop-vs-emit comparisons have K >= 3 (expert always available); K = 2 is the part 3 two-action copy arm

actions.loop: one more iteration of 48-59 for the current token; 3a + fills + next decision a
actions.emit: original layers 60-63 + lm_head on h60^(t); base cost
actions.expert: math tail: independent copy of 60-63 + r16 LoRA, shared prefix/loop/lm_head; trained on GSM8K train buckets 0-29 solutions and MATH train 7500, 2 epochs, lr 1e-4 with 5% warm-up and cosine decay to 1e-5, seed 17, on L0 mixed-depth h60; catch-up cost a per unprocessed token
actions.tool: bm25s over DPR psgs_w100 (21015324 passages); query = question or previous 64 tokens; top-5 (~675 tokens) as 'Retrieved:' + 'title: text' lines inserted after the position; prefilled at r=1 (layers 0-47, loop slot 1, generation tail, expert tail, copy slot 1), then loop slots 2-4 and copy slots 2-4 filled at once (12 F_fill = 0.080 F_0 per block token), charged to the separate retrieval ledger so later depth decisions never pay fills for the block; unscored; open at answer-first position for QA plus up to 4 hashed scored positions; at most one call per document; positions after an insertion compute layers 0-47 online (no prefix cache)
actions.ledger: per-document FLOPs of all executed items / (scored tokens * F_0); doc-mean; prompt region excluded; retrieval prefill and block fills reported separately and excluded from budget B
actions.wallclock: single GPU, batch 1 and 32, CUDA events per action, AB/BA interleaving with 8 warm-up and 56 timed runs per pair, teacher-forced NLL admission within 1e-4 of the scoring run, decode and full request separately, median and 95% interval; this is stage S10 (8 GPU-h) when run with part 3, and an extra 8 GPU-h outside the 133 when part 1 runs alone

part1_original.flow: prompt at r_q = 4 without decisions; per position: tool? -> loop* -> (emit | expert); generation stops at EOS or a new 'Question:' line

jev_training.tables: diagonal l(t|t) from one nested forward; expert NLL on each h60^(t); copy inputs per depth (10 KiB/token/depth)
jev_training.tool_label: C_tool = V^{T*}_1 + sum_{k=2..k_max}(l^T_{j+k} - l^0_{j+k}) + |S_d| * lambda_tool, k_max = min(32, n_d - j) (window truncated at the last scored token n_d); V^{T*}_1 = optimal cost at the block end on the insertion branch (4 nested iterations there, loop/emit/expert available, tool not, costs and backward recursion as section 9.3); window positions k >= 2 run r=1 emit on both branches (stated approximation); block fills are in the retrieval ledger, so C_tool carries no fill term; |S_d| converts the per-document call price into per-token units because the metric weights tokens by 1/|S_d| and the call rate counts per document
jev_training.coverage_correction: token-level regression on 256 calibration documents, L0 executed online with per-token random depths, two runs per document: dl ~ k0 + k_s s + k_e e, added to label costs; s = mean missing iterations over earlier positions (as v3.1); e = (d - max earlier depth)_+ (differs from v3.1, where e averaged how much deeper the history was)
jev_training.costs: C(t,a) = loss + nu * incremental cost; reference history by forward scan of hindsight-optimal actions
jev_training.dual_prices: nu: hindsight mean cost = B; lambda_tool: hindsight call rate = K; source-balanced weights; nu in {0} U {10^(-4 + 5k/400)}, k = 0..400, and lambda_tool in {10^(-3 + 4k/400)}, k = 0..400, nearest value on the grid (no bisection), alternating up to 10 rounds until two consecutive rounds agree
jev_training.exact_gradient: grad V_1 = sum_t rho_t (grad mu_t)^T C_t, rho_t = prod_{s<t} mu_s(loop); rho and C stop-gradient
jev_training.aux: A = sum_t sg(rho_t)[0.1 CE(y,mu) + 0.01 Brier(y,mu) + 0.1 KL(mu || mu_0)]

arms.J: A + 0.1 * sum_t sg(rho_t) LOO_t (M=64, alpha = 256 p_tilde + 0.001)

canopy_public.precision: BF16 activations, FP32 LoRA master, FP64 Dirichlet and actor

project_choices.optimizer: AdamW (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8, weight decay 0, constant lr
project_choices.record: all decision points of one document
project_choices.pool: GSM8K fit + fineweb fit + PopQA fit, about 14175 documents
project_choices.record_sampling: source uniformly, then a document uniformly within the source; about 1.9 / 1.7 / 0.6 epochs on GSM8K / fineweb / PopQA

jev_training.displacement_measurement: S1 records per-layer Frobenius norms of the Canopy adapter A, B and dW_0 = 2 B_0 A_0; each copy arm reports per-layer ||dW_end - dW_0||_F / ||dW_0||_F

evaluation.metric: source-balanced mean of GSM8K, fineweb and PopQA document-mean NLL
baselines: U: uniform depth r=1..4 without copy x tool rate {0, 0.5} (8 vertices)
evaluation.deploy_rule: argmax_a [l_t(a) - b_c dc_t(a) - b_k 1[a = tool]], l_t = unsmoothed prior logit
evaluation.fit_sets: GSM8K fit, fineweb fit and PopQA fit (lambda_tool calibrated on a set containing PopQA)

grid.tilt_upper_bounds: fixed on calibration before confirm: b_c_max = 2 x max over decision rows and available action pairs with larger incremental cost of (logit difference)/(cost difference); b_k_max = 2 x max over open positions of l(tool) - max other logit; an axis whose ratios are all non-positive uses {0} only
grid.parameter_grid: b_c in {0} U {b_c_max * 10^(-5 + 5i/200)}, b_k in {0} U {b_k_max * 10^(-5 + 5i/200)}, i = 0..200, Cartesian product
grid.prediction: predicted cost and call rate from a sequential table simulation (diagonal table plus coverage correction), no model forward
grid.clipping: cost targets clipped to [c_min + 0.002, c_max - 0.002], rate targets to [k_min + 0.005, k_max - 0.005] of the arm's reachable range on the grid
grid.selection: targets in lexicographic (cost, rate) order; nearest parameter; if its policy is already selected take the next nearest with a different policy; 16 distinct policies
grid.online_check: before confirm, the two parameters nearest (B,K) run online on calibration: |online - predicted cost| <= 0.01 and |online - predicted rate| <= 0.02; on failure the arm runs all 16 online on calibration and reselects by online cost and rate

evaluation.interpolation: barycentric weights in the Delaunay triangle containing (B,K); coordinates ((c-c0)/0.12, (k-k0)/0.20) with c0 = 1.19, k0 = 0.15 in part 1 and c0 = B - 0.06, k0 = K - 0.10 in S8; scipy Delaunay 'Qbb Qc Qz Q12 Qt'; find_simplex
evaluation.single_seed_note: conclusions limited to this training run

gpu_hours_notes.tool_forks: about 51000 forks (GSM8K 2615 x 5 + fineweb 3000 x 4 = about 25000, PopQA about 26000), about 700 tokens each, plus 4 iterations at the block end
gpu_hours_notes.online_eval: confirm sets about 1.8e6 tokens per run (GSM8K 0.70e6, fineweb 1.02e6, PopQA 0.07e6) plus retrieval blocks about 1.25e6; about 4.9 GPU-h of retrieval: about 1846 calls per run, 675-token block prefill at about 52.3 GF/token, block fills about 4.2 GF/token, online layers 0-47 after the insertion (about 37.3 GF/token, 100 tokens), 56 runs, about 4.3e18 FLOPs; confirm execution at about 0.8 F_0 per token, about 4.2e18 FLOPs, 4.7 GPU-h; FLOPs-based total about 10 GPU-h, plan 20 because per-token online execution is memory-bandwidth bound (revised after K7)

tests.D2: L_R(B) - L_E-tok*(B), one-sided; E-tok* seeds pooled (per-document mean over the three seeds, then document bootstrap; cross-seed generalisation by the multi-seed rule); per-token copy arm with exact gradient, two actions, lr*
tests.D3: L_H-chunk(B) - L_COPY-REG(B), one-sided; seed 17 only, conclusion limited to this training

equivalence.rule: 90% interval inside (-0.002, 0.002) under both adjacent-point and lower-convex-hull interpolation; the algorithm-level claim 'J and E equivalent' also needs the df-2 90% t interval of the three seed differences inside; with the bootstrap condition alone the claim is 'equivalent on these three trainings'
equivalence.power_forecast: before confirm, estimate sigma_JE on calibration and forecast power at n = 2814 by appendix D.2; below 0.8 the lock file declares 'equivalence underpowered, interval only'; power is 0 when sigma_JE >= 0.0645

test_families.conclusion_intervals: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided intervals at level 1 - 0.05/m within the family (m = tests actually run); unadjusted 95% intervals reported descriptively
test_families.decision_tiers: detected -> gain; not detected and adjusted upper < 0 -> not better; not detected and 0 <= upper < delta -> below threshold; otherwise (adjusted upper >= delta, or bracket failure) undetermined (no deployment change); D5 detected positive -> chunk readout better; D5 not detected with the adjusted interval inside (-delta, delta) -> difference below threshold, deploy the chunk readout; G1 is a calibration gate, not a test: its failure is reported as 'admission condition not met' with point estimate and lower bound

T.direction: one-sided > 0; positive favours H-tool (accuracy effects favour the first term)

part3_execution.accuracy_resolution_rule: GSM8K accuracy co-primary for A1 and D1 only if base calibration greedy accuracy in [0.2, 0.9] (K8); the D1 accuracy version generates on 6 grid points per family for R and H-chunk (offsets +-0.006, +-0.020, +-0.045); 4 points at +-0.002 and +-0.006 would make a bracket failure almost certain under the section 19.4 bound

chunks.GSM8K: one line per chunk, lines over 64 tokens split
chunks.fineweb: sentence end or newline, at most 32 tokens

depth.decision_input: h60 at the last position of the previous chunk at its executed depth; first chunk reads the prompt end at r_q = 4
tables: chunk table l_c(d|k), k,d in 1..4, from uniform-k runs with forks at chunk boundaries and per-(k,d) filled running states

arms.R: ridge on [one-hot previous depth k; 10 position features] (14); rows: scored chunk x 4 k; target l_c(d|k), d = 1..4; alpha grid 1e-2..1e4
arms.H-chunk: ridge on [h60; one-hot previous depth k; phi] (5134); same rows and targets as R; alpha 1e3..1e7
arms.H-tok: ridge on [h60^(t); one-hot t; phi] (5134), 25% hashed positions; alpha 1e3..1e7
arms.H-req: ridge on prompt-end h60 + source + prompt length; alpha 1e1..1e5
arms.COPY-REG: copy (Canopy adapter init) + bias-free Linear(5134->4) on [standardised copy output; one-hot(k); phi_c] (the constant column's weight is the intercept); standardisation statistics computed once on the fit set with the copy at initialisation and then fixed; head initialised by the default nn.Linear distribution with init seed 17; squared loss on l_c(d|k), same rows as H-chunk; AdamW 2 epochs, batch 8, lr preselected in {1e-5,1e-4,1e-3}; seed 17 only; gate G2
arms.COPY-RND: as COPY-REG (same 5134-dim input, same head distribution and init seed) with the copy LoRA increment zeroed (B = 0, A kaiming); the two arms differ only in the copy LoRA initial value; own lr preselection; seed 17 only; COPY-REG minus COPY-RND is descriptive, seed 17 only; gate G2
arms.E-tok*: copy + 10-slot prior, exact expectation, loop/emit only; lr* from {1e-6,1e-5,1e-4} by the mean calibration-table V_1 of the seed-17 lr preselection runs of E-tok* and J-tok* (1881 updates each); the two runs at the chosen lr are the seed-17 E-tok* and J-tok*; seeds 17, 23, 31; gate G2
arms.J-tok*: as E-tok* with Dirichlet LOO M=64, same lr*; seeds 17 (the preselection run at lr*), 23, 31; gate G2
arms.J640: as J-tok* with M=640; seed 17; gate G2
arms.J-tok, E-tok, S-tok (faithful): part 1 recipe at lr 1e-6; seed 20261023; gate G2
arms.Canopy zero-training: predict, request level, chat template ending 'The answer is ('; one 64-layer prefill charged; diagnostic

position_features: constant 1 (not standardised; the sole unpenalised intercept)
depth.chunk_representation: h60^(k)_{c-1}: h60 at the last position of chunk c-1 under previous depth k (section 15.2), standardised like the other features
depth.first_chunk_rows: previous depth k = prompt depth 4; the four k rows coincide, one row kept
depth.ridge_selection: 5-fold document-grouped CV on the fit set, squared error; per-dimension standardisation except the constant column, which is the sole unpenalised intercept (dimension counts 14 and 5134 include it); one-hot(k) sums to the constant column, the ridge penalty on the one-hot columns keeps the solution unique; H-req adds the same intercept column
depth.je_admission_K10: 400 records, M=64: aggregate cosine >= 0.99 and relative error <= 5%
depth.decision_rule_chunk: argmin_d [l_hat(d) + kappa_s s_c(d) + kappa_e e_c(d) + nu (3a(d-1) + 3f n_c(d) / m_bar)]
depth.decision_rule_token_ridge: continue iff min_{d>t}[l_hat(d|t) + coverage + nu(3a(d-t) + 3f n)] < l_hat(t|t) + coverage(t)
depth.decision_rule_token_copy: loop iff l_t(loop) - l_t(emit) > b [4a + 3f n + f n_copy], l_t = unsmoothed prior logit; b on the logit grid of policy_grid; same score for part 1 J/E/S and S8 U-E/U-J; E-tool/J-tool/CAT rank by l(A) - l(B)
depth.second_round: all trained readouts: run round 1 online on fit documents, fork 8 hashed decision points per document on the policy's own state, merge rows, retrain; lock the round with lower calibration online NLL at B
depth.coverage_regression: 256 calibration documents (192 GSM8K, 64 fineweb), chunk-random and token-random depths, two runs each; token-weighted fit of dl ~ k0 + k_s s + k_e e; FA deepest-available forward-only diagnostic
depth.split_half: odd/even scored tokens within each chunk: select on one half, evaluate on the other, swap and average
depth.main_budget: selected on the fit set: largest split-half gain over R (R fitted on the fit set) among the feasible tiers of {1.089, 1.178, 1.268} (B >= 1 + a + 0.022 = 1.082; applies always because B is chosen before G2); secondary for R and H-chunk only, the adjacent higher tier of all three (adjacent lower if the main is the highest); locked value is the measured ledger cost of the uniform mixture on calibration; G2 computed on calibration

policy_grid.price_grid: ridge and copy-regression readouts: nu in {0} U 10^(-4 + 5k/2000), k = 0..2000
policy_grid.logit_tilt_grid: per-token copy arms (logit score): b in {0} U {b_max * 10^(-5 + 5k/2000)}, k = 0..2000; b_max fixed before confirm as 2 x the maximum over calibration rows of (l(loop) - l(emit)) / (4a + 3f n + f n_copy); smoothed flips already reach 19.48, above the nu grid's upper end 10
policy_grid.target_clipping: targets clipped to [c_min + 0.002, c_max - 0.002] of the family's predicted cost range on its grid; copy arms have c_min >= 1 + a = 1.0595 (at B = 1.089 the targets 1.044 and 1.059 are unreachable and are separated by the duplicate rule); with c_min = 1 + a the main-budget feasibility rule keeps at least 4 targets below B
policy_grid.duplicates: targets processed in increasing cost; if the nearest parameter yields an already selected policy (same predicted cost), move to the next parameter with a different predicted cost; 12 distinct policies
policy_grid.cliff_check: if the two calibration parameters bracketing B differ in predicted cost by more than 0.02, take 2000 log-spaced parameter values between them and add the one nearest the midpoint; repeat until <= 0.02, at most 4 added points per family; report if still > 0.02
policy_grid.sensitivity: every family also reports lower-convex-hull interpolation; main tests use adjacent-point interpolation; equivalence needs both

online_evaluation.confirm_runs: 204, plus at most 4 per family from the cliff check
online_evaluation.prefix_cache: valid: S5 inserts no retrieval blocks

depth.per_token_copy_trainings: 24: E-tok* and J-tok* seed-17 lr preselection 3 each, first round 8 more, second round 10; about 0.42 GPU-h each

expert.tail: independent copy of 60-63 + r16 LoRA trained on base r=1 h60; own AdamW; evaluation at r=1
arms: H-route: ridge on prompt-end h60 + source predicting L_exp - L_base; alpha 1e1..1e5
expert.cost_note: per-question choice has no FLOPs cost; pure quality comparison without interpolation
expert.gate_GX: expert tail NLL on GSM8K calibration at r=1 at least 0.02 below the base tail AND per-question split-half gain over static >= 0.005

tool.task: PopQA at base r=1; greedy up to 32 tokens; stop at newline or EOS; correct if any possible_answers is a case-insensitive substring
tool.retrieval: bm25s English tokenisation with English stopwords, default scoring parameters recorded; top-5 appended after the question; index built on CPU in S0, mmap, SHA256 per file
tool.offline_exact_evaluation: both executions per question; any per-question policy evaluated exactly by lookup
arms: POP: retrieve iff s_pop below threshold
H-tool: ridge on prompt-end h60 predicting Y1 - Y0
E-tool: copy + slots A/B, exact expectation; ranked by the unsmoothed logit difference l(A) - l(B)
J-tool: Dirichlet LOO M=64; ranked by l(A) - l(B)
CAT: one sampled action per record, leave-one-out baseline over the batch; ranked by l(A) - l(B)
tool.copy_arm_ranking_score: E-tool, J-tool and CAT rank questions by l(A) - l(B) and the rate-grid thresholds are set on this score; mu or log pi would tie on saturated rows (K = 2 smoothing)
tool.training: PopQA fit (about 8560), 1881 updates x 8, aux as part 1, lambda_tool dual price for rate K, lr = lr* (or preselect E-tool in {1e-6,1e-5,1e-4} if S5 ran no per-token copy arms)
tool.rate_grid: 12 thresholds at K + {+-0.005, +-0.015, +-0.03, +-0.05, +-0.08, +-0.12}; exact interpolation in rate
tool.gate_GT: calibration oracle at K=0.5 at least 4 pp above POP
tool.power: sd(D) planned 0.5 (discordance <= 0.25); se = 0.0084 at 3570; MDE 2.1 pp one-sided 0.05 power 0.8; 2.6 pp if discordance 0.4

unified_S8.condition_GU: at least two of depth (D1 or D2), expert (X), tool (T) conclude 'gain'; decided on confirm, applies to U-E and the decomposed arm alike (same opened dimensions)
arms: U-E: part 1 structure opening only the actions of passed dimensions (four actions only when all three pass), exact expectation, seed 17; lr = lr* from S5, else the E-tool preselected lr from S7, else preselected in {1e-6,1e-5,1e-4} by calibration-table V_1 within the S8 20 GPU-h; deploy on the unsmoothed prior logit
U-J: same with J and the same lr

decomposed: same opened dimensions as U-E; each component chosen on calibration and written to lock_unified.json before confirm is read: depth = lowest GSM8K calibration NLL at B among the R, H-chunk and E-tok* that ran; expert = lower calibration NLL of static rule and H-route (if GX passed); tool = higher PopQA calibration accuracy at K = 0.5 of POP and H-tool (if GT passed)
unified_S8.unopened_dimensions: both arms use depth r = 1, the generation tail, no retrieval; without depth, family U interpolates in rate only (section 17.5 rule) and reports the U-E copy-cost difference; without tool, family U interpolates in cost only (section 19.3 rule)
unified_S8.selection_bias_note: components are chosen on calibration, not by confirm-set test results, so the decomposed arm is not optimistically selected on the documents of family U
unified_S8.prefix_cache: runs with retrieval insertion read the h48 cache before the insertion and compute layers 0-47 online for the block and later positions; included in the 0-20 GPU-h
unified_S8.metric: source-balanced NLL at (B,K) by barycentric interpolation; PopQA accuracy secondary

budget_point.K_reason: S8 call rate is source-balanced over three sources as in part 1; the tool dimension's K = 0.5 is a PopQA-only rate

unified_S8.grid: 16 per arm (U-E, U-J, decomposed) by the part 1 two-dimensional selection rule: cost B + {-0.06,-0.02,0.02,0.06} x rate K + {-0.10,-0.04,0.04,0.10}; decomposed parameters are the Cartesian product of the depth price grid and tool-score thresholds; unreachable targets clipped as in part 1 (e.g. B = 1.089 gives B - 0.06 = 1.029 below the U-E floor 1 + a = 1.0595)

data_roles.bucket_function: int(hashlib.sha256(b'jev-v4\x00' + text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(), 16) % 100; question text for GSM8K and PopQA, full text for fineweb

gsm8k_train.dev: expert-training buckets double as the S2 dev set

gsm8k_test.exposure: used as Huginn confirm set in v3.3 (1310 after Huginn length filter); reuse noted in the report

fineweb_source.continuation: training rows beyond shard 0 continue with train-00001-of-00234 onward in file-name order, whole shards, same row index definition, bytes and SHA256 recorded per file

popqa.rows: about 14.3k (test split only; exact count recorded)

data_roles.training_rows: fineweb-edu-dedup shard 0 rows >= 400000 (412684 rows), then later shards per fineweb_source.continuation; v2 used 24096-199999, loopjev 0-24095 of the same file and row order
data_roles.decontamination: 13-gram (NFKC, lowercase, punctuation removed, whitespace tokens) against GSM8K, MATH, PopQA questions and answers
data_roles.confirm_sealed: each stage reads the confirm sets only after writing its own lock file: family A after lock_loop.json (S3), S5 after lock_depth.json, S6 after lock_expert.json, S7 after lock_tool.json, S8 after lock_unified.json
data_roles.format: 'Question: {q}\nAnswer:' prompt; GSM8K '####' line removed; plain vs chat template chosen by K8

bootstrap.type: paired document bootstrap, stratified by source for source-balanced metrics; all costs, losses, endpoints, weights and triangles recomputed per resample

statistics.iso_cost: adjacent pair bracketing B; L_a(B) = L_- + (B - c_-)/(c_+ - c_-) (L_+ - L_-), exact loss of the document-level mixture; lower-convex-hull interpolation reported as sensitivity
statistics.bracket_failure: any resample without a bracketing pair makes the interval not estimable; no clipping, no dropping; the test gets p = 1
statistics.bracket_failure_planning: v3.3: sigma_378 = 0.0053/1.7426 = 0.003041, per-document 0.059; scaled to the W3 cost range, per-document cost sd <= 0.273; resample sd <= 0.0051 at 2814 (grid ends 0.045 away: 8.8 sd, 6.8 sd after a 0.01 calibration-to-confirm shift) and <= 0.0086 at 1000 (5.2 sd, 4.1 sd after the shift)
statistics.holm: per family, family-wise 0.05; D4 and D5 use two-sided p; m = number of tests actually run; no claim across families
statistics.conclusion_intervals: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided level 1 - 0.05/m within family (97.5%, 98.3%, 98.75%, 99%, 99.2%, 95% for m = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 1)
statistics.tost: two one-sided tests at 0.05 each, margin 0.002; both interpolations; power forecast on calibration before confirm, below 0.8 declare underpowered
statistics.multi_seed: training-algorithm conclusions (family A, E-tok*, J-tok*) need all three seed estimates to share the pooled sign; df-2 t interval reported; COPY-REG and COPY-RND are seed 17 only, D3 limited to that training

family_D_m5.note: detect values are conservative for D1-D3 (one-sided); D4 and D5 use the two-sided rows (true direction)

statistics.signs: effects are first term minus second term; for NLL a positive effect favours the second term, for accuracy a positive effect favours the first term

pending_user_decisions: 节点总时长预算（GPU 小时上限）。按 u=0.25 规划，全计划约 523 GPU 小时（约 65 小时节点时间），其中种子 23 与 31 的 L/N 训练约 260 GPU 小时；不运行它们时约 263 GPU 小时，族 A 的结论只能限于种子 17 这一次训练。

是否单独完整执行第一部分的原始实验（L0 全量训练与四动作逐 token 决策，约 133 GPU 小时，墙钟测量另需约 8 GPU 小时）。不单独执行时，原始形态的两动作版本（E-tok*、J-tok*、J640 与学习率 1e-6 的 J-tok、E-tok、S-tok）只在 G1 与 G2 都通过时运行；统一决策器版本（S8 的 U-E、U-J）只开放通过的维度，深度、专家、工具三维都检出时才是四动作版本，只在 GU 通过且 S8 未被削减时运行；原始形态可能完全得不到检验。替代选项：(a) 让 J-tok（学习率 1e-6 的忠实臂）与 E-tok* 只受 G1 约束、不受 G2 约束，费用为这两族的训练与在线评价加上 lr* 预选的 6 次训练，计入 S5 的上限 80 GPU 小时；G2 不通过时族 D 的检验为 D1、D2、D4、D5（m=4，正确率列入时为 5），J-tok* 的种子 23、31 与 J640 不运行，等效检验不做；(b) 为逐 token 副本臂另设门槛，用相邻两个计分 token 互为选择与评价的逐 token 分半上界，相对 R 至少 0.005 时运行。
“其他专家”的具体对象。默认是数学领域 LoRA 生成尾，共享前缀与循环，按题选择时没有 FLOPs 代价。备选是外部同构模型（如 Qwen3.6-27B，需另下载约 55.6 GB，并核对分词器与许可）或同一权重的思考模式。
检索语料与许可。DPR psgs_w100（21,015,324 段，2018-12-20 快照）所在仓库标注 CC-BY-NC 4.0，Wikipedia 正文为 CC BY-SA，能否在本项目中使用；PopQA 数据卡没有写许可，是否接受使用。
循环训练所用的数学网页语料：OpenWebMath 还是 Nemotron-CC-Math-v1-4plus，以及该语料的许可是否可以接受。

执行时逐项批准下载：Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B@1d4bf0f（18 个分片，55,562,855,904 B）、Camellia86/Canopy-Jev-27B@b262895f（adapter 25,039,208 B、prior 205,188 B、manifest 4,725 B 与许可文件）、Canopy-Jev 代码@b71f97b、两个 venv 的 pip 轮子、GSM8K、MATH train、PopQA、DPR psgs_w100（解压约 13 GB，下载前核对）、fineweb-edu-dedup 分片（第 0 号分片 2,395,121,191 B）、数学语料、bm25s；必要时还有节点上的 Python 解释器与备选栈；本机冒烟另需 WSL2 中的 Linux 轮子与 Qwen 分词器文件。

是否接受第一部分对原始想法的偏离与几项设计解释（计划第 1.3 节的偏离表）：循环段取 0–59 内以第 59 层结束的对齐段（第一部分为 [48–59]，第三部分由先导在 [56–59]、[52–59]、[48–59] 中选择），整段 [0–59] 只用于零训练诊断；第一部分在循环段迭代≥2 上挂 18,776,064 个 LoRA 参数，偏离'前 60 层冻结'；'选择循环次数'有三种读法（请求级、逐迭代、一次选择，计划第 1.1 节），第一部分取逐迭代读法，是否在第三部分增设一次选择读法的副本臂（副本读第一次迭代的出口直接选 r∈{1,2,3,4}，另设 expert 与 tool 两个槽，每 token 只付一次副本开销 a）；工具调用单列调用预算 K；第三部分中专家与工具按题决策、深度按块决策。

节点上 logind 的 KillUserProcesses 为 yes 且账户没有 linger 时，SSH 断开会终止长作业，setsid nohup 也不能避免；这种情形需要管理员执行 loginctl enable-linger 或把账户加入 KillExcludeUsers，这一操作由谁执行。KillUserProcesses=no 或在容器中运行时用 setsid nohup 托管，不需要管理员操作。
GSM8K test 在 v3.3 中已用作 Huginn 上的确认集，是否接受在 27B 上再次把它用作确认集（报告中注明这一暴露）。
实用门槛是否沿用 NLL 0.005 nat/token 与正确率 2 个百分点。
循环门槛 G1 不通过时，是否另行立项投入 1e10 token 量级的全参数或更大规模改造（8×H200 上需数周）。
实验结束、结果拉回本机后，节点上的模型、数据与中间缓存是否删除。
